archetype: The Performance Pro & Slate IDE (Unreal Engine Editor Inspired)
context: Developer Tool / AI System Generator for Game Developers
theme: Dark Mode Default (Unreal Engine 5 Editor Dark Slate & Vibrant Accents)

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl md:text-4xl font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider font-display
hierarchy.caption: text-xs text-muted-foreground font-mono

layout_and_structure.type: IDE Workspace Layout with Modular Dock Panels & Tabbed Main View
structure_components: Top Header Bar with UE5 Engine Version Badge, System Selector, Presets, Export All & Theme Info
Left Sidebar (Width ~320px / Collapsible): AI Prompt Synthesizer, Quick Modular Templates Library (Combat, Inventory, AI, Dialogue, Save System, Ability System, Vehicle), Local Saved Library Manager

Center Canvas / Main Stage: System Header with Tunable Slider Quick Bar, Tabbed View (Blueprint Visual Node Graph Canvas, Blueprint Pseudocode, C++ Header & Source Snippets, Step-by-Step Node-by-Node Setup Guide)

Right Inspector / Tuner Panel (Width ~340px / Collapsible): System Parameter Sliders (Complexity, Modularity, Performance vs Flexibility, Tick Rate, Network Replicated Toggle), Dynamic Add/Subtract Component Chips, Variable Matrix, Export & Copy Controls
Bottom Status & Diagnostics Bar: Replicated Status, Memory Overhead, Blueprint Class Type (Actor, Pawn, Character, ActorComponent), Generation Log Console
layout_and_structure.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard p-2 to p-6 for tight developer tool density without clutter.

visual_enhancers.grid_pattern: Unreal Blueprint Canvas Dot/Cross Grid background using SVG repeating patterns (#182030 grid line on #0B0E14)
visual_enhancers.node_cards: Dark rounded slate nodes (rounded-md border border-[#283348]) with distinct colored top header bars (Execution = Dark Gray, Event = Crimson Red, Function = Blueprint Blue, Pure Math = Green)
visual_enhancers.node_wires: SVG Curved cubic bezier connecting cables with glowing animated particle pulses showing signal execution flow
visual_enhancers.code_highlighter: Syntax highlighting with C++ keyword colors (class, public, UPROPERTY, UFUNCTION in Unreal Orange and Cyan) and Blueprint pin color indicators (Red = Boolean, Green = Float, Cyan = Integer, Blue = Object, Gold = Vector)
visual_enhancers.slider_style: Industrial UE5 style sliders with numerical entry boxes, quick reset buttons, and instant preview recalculation

key_features_to_build.1_describe_to_system_generator: Natural language prompt bar ('e.g. Turn-based grid combat system with action points and UE5 Gameplay Ability System integration') + parameter presets. Simulates AI system synthesis with live streaming code & visual nodes generation.
2_multi_tab_outputs: Visual Node Graph: Interactive SVG canvas with zoom/pan, dragging nodes, hovering pins, execution flow animations, and node detail tooltip
Blueprint Pseudocode: Formatted, highlighted UE5 Blueprint logic structure with node connection tree and pin specs
C++ Code Snippets: Clean Header (.h) and Implementation (.cpp) snippets with UPROPERTY(EditAnywhere, BlueprintReadWrite), UFUNCTION(BlueprintCallable), and UE5 macros

Step-by-Step Setup Guide: Interactive checklist showing required UE5 Asset Creation (e.g. Content Browser > New Blueprint Class > ActorComponent), Component Setup, Event Graph Wiring, and Testing Procedure
key_features_to_build.3_tunable_sliders_and_modifiers: Dynamic customization sliders (e.g. Max Inventory Slots, Attack Combo Stages, AI Sight Radius, Tick Frequency, Network Sync Level) that dynamically update generated code, pseudocode, and node graphs in real-time.
key_features_to_build.4_add_subtract_modular_components: Interactive chip-based Modular Extension Manager allowing users to add modules (e.g. '+ Add Stamina Drain', '+ Add Sound FX Cues', '+ Add Save State Serialization', '- Remove Camera Shake') which updates the code/graph instantly.
key_features_to_build.5_prebuilt_template_library: Filterable preset cards for core game systems: 1) Advanced Combo Combat, 2) Grid & Slot Inventory, 3) Branching Dialogue & Quest System, 4) Behavior Tree AI Guard, 5) Save/Load Game State, 6) Vehicle Physics Controller, 7) Gas Ability System.
key_features_to_build.6_personal_library_manager: Save generated or customized systems to browser LocalStorage with custom naming, tags, export JSON, load preset, and delete options.

testing_and_data_attributes.guideline: ALL interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, sliders, template cards, and copy triggers MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do NOT use generic light/white theme by default. Maintain strict dark Slate / UE5 Editor styling (#0B0E14 background).
Ensure all code views have syntax highlighting styling, code block headers with language badges, and one-click copy/download actions.
Ensure the Node Graph canvas supports dragging/panning or zoom, node selecting, and clear execution wire rendering.
Use Lucide icons for high quality developer icons (Cpu, Code, Layers, Sliders, Play, Save, Download, Copy, Plus, Trash2, CheckCircle2, Terminal, Sparkles, Box).
Make sure every slider and modifier component seamlessly re-calculates or triggers state updates so the UI feels alive and responsive.
Add sonner toasts on copy, save, and system generation events.
